Title

``` The real strengths are **not "typing faster"**: 1. **No naming** — a large share of CSS debate in a team is debate about class names. 2. **CSS size barely grows with page count** — utilities are reused; only the HTML gets longer. 3. **Bound to design tokens** — `p-4`, `text-lg` come from a fixed scale, so drifting off the system is hard.
